evidence: docs/flows/download.batch.mmd and docs/flows/contracts.md describe the submission, replay, rollback, and browser retry boundaries implemented in src/uav_downloader/daemon/download_batch.py and uav-web/frontend/download-batch.js.

The base-to-candidate diff changes task execution and publication retry behavior in src/uav_downloader/daemon/task_manager.py and src/uav_downloader/daemon/nas.py; it does not change batch submission, the frontend request, or its HTTP forwarding.

src/uav_downloader/daemon/download_batch.py determines destination occupancy from nonterminal task statuses. The new retry wrapper retains the preparing status between attempts, consistent with the documented unfinished-task occupancy rule.
tests/test_daemon_downloads.py contains batch replay, destination occupancy, rollback, retry, cancellation, and pause scenarios; tests/download_batch.cjs covers the frontend batch flow.
limitations: This was a read-only semantic review; application code and tests were not executed, and test execution results were not supplied.
